overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. A name mentioned in open session before an executive session on a pending MCAD complaint was not unlawful, since the law does not bar open discussion or require members to keep executive session topics confidential.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee improperly revealed, in open session, the identity of an individual to be discussed in a February 2 executive session on a pending MCAD complaint.
